title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `url_launcher`
description: pubspec.yaml declares a declared package name in pubspec.yaml within one edit of `url_launcher`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The Dart toolchain resolves these names against pub.dev, so a name that only looks like the intended package brings foreign code into the app. The name this rule expects is `url_launcher`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The Dart toolchain resolves these names against pub.dev, so a name that only looks like the intended package brings foreign code into the app. The name this rule expects is `url_launcher`.
